notes.title: New Level: Ultimate Leaderboard Challenge
notes.content:
Calling all Racers -

As competition heats up on the leaderboards, we introduce one last ultimate challenge level featuring some of the fastest cars and a difficult track.

Think you have what it takes to be the best? The top 10 players on the leaderboard by the end of the Steam Next Fest will be permanently featured on our website!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718521/89289c1e4858c9c0f93f55ffa6781e301a936354.png

Also join us on Steam for our live stream, where the developers play Delivery Missions, a special game mode featuring fully procedurally generated levels and explore offroad in some of the maps!

See you on the tracks in Rogue Racer!

Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/764420/Rogue_Racer/
